ceza-hukuku.title: Criminal Law
ceza-hukuku.short: Effective and rights-oriented defense during investigation and prosecution.
ceza-hukuku.description:
Criminal law is a critical legal branch covering acts defined as crimes, applicable sanctions, and the investigation and prosecution phases. Since it directly impacts personal freedom and rights, obtaining professional legal support from the very beginning prevents loss of rights.

**Core Legal Processes Covered:**
• **Investigation Phase:** Statements, police/prosecutor interrogations, custody, search, seizure, and appeals against detention or judicial control.
• **Prosecution Phase:** Evaluation of indictments, trial representation, and defense in Criminal Courts.
• **Victim & Complainant Representation:** Filing complaints, collecting and submitting evidence, and joining criminal proceedings.
• **Legal Remedies:** Appeals to higher courts and Supreme Court proceedings.

**Common Case Types:**
• Intentional or negligent injury / homicide
• Crimes against property (Theft, fraud, breach of trust)
• Crimes against personal rights (Threats, insult, blackmail, violation of privacy)

aile-hukuku.title: Family Law
aile-hukuku.short: Attentive legal guidance in divorce, custody, alimony, and domestic disputes.
aile-hukuku.description:
Family law regulates marriage, divorce, lineage, and financial relations within the family. It must be managed with utmost care, prioritizing the best interests of all parties and especially children.

**Practice Areas & Services:**
• **Divorce Cases:** Drafting uncontested divorce agreements; managing fault determination, compensation, and proceedings in contested divorces.
• **Custody & Alimony:** Child custody, visitation schedules, and claims or adjustments for child and spousal support.
• **Property Regime & Division:** Pre/post-nuptial agreements, division of marital assets, and liquidation lawsuits.
• **Protective Measures:** Injunctions and protection orders under domestic violence prevention laws.
• **Other Disputes:** Paternity claims, adoption, and compensation claims arising from broken engagements.

icra-iflas-hukuku.title: Enforcement and Bankruptcy Law
icra-iflas-hukuku.short: Debt collection, execution proceedings, foreclosure, and debt restructuring.
icra-iflas-hukuku.description:
Enforcement and bankruptcy law governs the legal collection of individual and commercial receivables and the resolution of debt relations. Rapid action is essential due to strict statutory deadlines.

**Services for Creditors:**
• Execution proceedings based on court judgments, contracts, or negotiable instruments (cheques, promissory notes).
• Asset tracing, attachment (garnishment), and liquidation of seized assets.
• Prosecution of bad cheque cases and enforcement offense claims.

**Services for Debtors:**
• Appeals against unlawful execution proceedings, debts, and signatures.
• Negative clearance (non-indebtedness) and restitution lawsuits.
• Complaints against non-attachability and execution officer actions.

**Corporate Services:**
• Concordat proceedings, bankruptcy, debt restructuring, and creditors' meeting management.

is-hukuku.title: Labor and Social Security Law
is-hukuku.short: Counseling on employee-employer disputes, employment contracts, and SSI processes.
is-hukuku.description:
Labor law regulates rights and duties in working life. We provide legal counsel to both employees and employers, from mandatory mediation to litigation.

**Employee Rights & Claims:**
• Severance, notice pay, overtime, annual leave, and public holiday pay.
• Reinstatement lawsuits and management of mobbing (psychological harassment) cases.
• Compensation claims arising from work accidents and occupational diseases.

**Corporate Employer Counseling:**
• Drafting employment contracts, HR files, and internal company policies.
• Managing termination notices, warnings, and legally compliant dismissals.

**Social Security (SSI) Disputes:**
• Service determination (unregistered work) lawsuits, insurance premium days, and retirement disputes.

ticaret-hukuku.title: Commercial Law
ticaret-hukuku.short: Corporate law, commercial contracts, and resolution of business disputes.
ticaret-hukuku.description:
Commercial law safeguards business operations and corporate transactions. Preventive legal counseling is essential to eliminate risks before they arise.

**Core Practice Areas:**
• **Corporate Law:** Company formation, articles of association, general assembly and board management, share transfers, mergers and acquisitions.
• **Commercial Contracts:** Drafting and reviewing distribution, agency, sales, supply, NDA, and consultancy contracts.
• **Dispute Resolution:** Commercial debt recovery, unfair competition lawsuits, shareholder disputes, and board liability litigation.
• **Alternative Dispute Resolution:** Mandatory commercial mediation and arbitration representation.

gayrimenkul-hukuku.title: Real Estate Law
gayrimenkul-hukuku.short: Legal assurance in title deed, lease, condominium, and property projects.
gayrimenkul-hukuku.description:
Analyzing the legal status of high-value real estate before executing contracts or title registrations prevents potential financial losses.

**Key Services:**
• **Title Deed & Property Litigation:** Cancellation and registration of title deeds, pre-emption rights, prevention of trespass, and mesne profits (unlawful occupation compensation).
• **Lease Law:** Eviction lawsuits, rent determination, lease adjustments, and drafting lease agreements.
• **Condominium Law:** Apartment/site management disputes, common expense (dues) recovery, and management plan drafting.
• **Expropriation:** Determination and increase of expropriation compensation, and unlawful seizure without expropriation.

miras-hukuku.title: Inheritance Law
miras-hukuku.short: Guidance on estate division, wills, reduction claims, and inheritance disputes.
miras-hukuku.description:
Inheritance law governs the fair and lawful distribution of a deceased person's estate among legal and appointed heirs.

**Services Offered:**
• **Planning & Preparation:** Drafting wills, inheritance contracts, and agreement for care until death.
• **Transfer & Division:** Certificate of inheritance, estate determination, disclaimer of inheritance, and dissolution of co-ownership lawsuits.
• **Inheritance Disputes:** Collusive estate transfers (muris muvazaası), reduction lawsuits for reserved shares, and equalization claims.

sozlesmeler-hukuku.title: Contract Law
sozlesmeler-hukuku.short: Drafting, reviewing, risk analysis, and termination of all types of contracts.
sozlesmeler-hukuku.description:
Well-drafted contracts convert oral agreements into enforceable rules, acting as the strongest defense against future disputes.

**Service Details:**
• **Contract Drafting:** Custom contracts containing penal clauses, termination conditions, force majeure, and jurisdiction clauses.
• **Contract Review:** Identifying adverse clauses and providing risk analysis reports for third-party contracts.
• **Performance & Termination:** Issuing default notices, managing breach of contract, contract termination, and penalty claims.

tuketici-hukuku.title: Consumer Law
tuketici-hukuku.short: Legal support for defective goods/services, right of withdrawal, and consumer claims.
tuketici-hukuku.description:
Consumer law protects buyers against unfair practices, defective goods, and service failures while ensuring seller compliance with regulations.

**Legal Support Areas:**
• Exercising optional rights (refund, replacement, free repair) for defective goods and services.
• Applications to Consumer Arbitration Committees and appeals against decisions.
• Compensation and refund litigation in Consumer Courts.
• Legal protection regarding distance sales, subscription contracts, and unfair bank terms.

milletlerarasi-ozel-hukuk.title: Private International Law
milletlerarasi-ozel-hukuk.short: Counseling on cross-border disputes, recognition-enforcement, and citizenship.
milletlerarasi-ozel-hukuk.description:
Disputes involving foreign elements, international jurisdiction, and applicable foreign laws require specialized cross-border legal expertise.

**Practice Areas:**
• **Recognition & Enforcement:** Enforcing foreign court judgments (divorce, commercial, compensation) within local jurisdiction.
• **International Family & Estate:** Cross-border divorce, custody, alimony, and inheritance of international assets.
• **Foreigners Law:** Work and residence permits, citizenship by investment applications, and real estate acquisitions for foreigners.

tazminat-hukuku.title: Compensation Law
tazminat-hukuku.short: Claiming material and moral damages, bodily injury, and insurance litigation.
tazminat-hukuku.description:
Compensation law aims to remedy financial and emotional distress caused by torts, breach of contract, or statutory liability.

**Compensation Claim Types:**
• **Traffic & Work Accidents:** Death, disability, loss of earning capacity, medical expenses, loss of support, and vehicle depreciation.
• **Violation of Personal Rights:** Moral damages for defamation, libel, or online privacy violations.
• **Medical Malpractice:** Compensation claims for damages resulting from medical negligence.
• **Insurance Claims:** Resolving disputes with insurance companies and handling Insurance Arbitration cases.

fikri-mulkiyet-hukuku.title: Intellectual Property Law
fikri-mulkiyet-hukuku.short: Protection of trademarks, patents, designs, copyrights, and trade secrets.
fikri-mulkiyet-hukuku.description:
Covers the registration, protection, licensing, and enforcement of creative, technical, and commercial intangible assets.

**Scope of Services:**
• Trademark, patent, and industrial design applications, oppositions, and renewals.
• Litigation against trademark/patent infringement, cease and desist notices, and damage claims.
• Copyright protection, software licensing, digital asset protection, and transfer agreements.
• Domain name disputes and unfair competition litigation.

bilisim-hukuku.title: IT & Cyber Law
bilisim-hukuku.short: GDPR/KVKK compliance, cybercrime, e-commerce, and digital business law.
bilisim-hukuku.description:
Addresses legal relations, data privacy, e-commerce regulations, and digital offenses arising from computer systems and the internet.

**Core Activities:**
• **Data Protection Compliance:** GDPR/KVKK compliance, privacy notices, consent forms, and data security consulting.
• **Cybercrimes:** Legal prosecution for hacked accounts, online banking fraud, and unauthorized system access.
• **Digital Content & Privacy:** Removal of online content (right to be forgotten) and obtaining access blocking orders.
• **E-Commerce Legal Support:** Drafting distance sales contracts, membership terms, and privacy policies for websites.
